verdict.rationale: Sales Cloud's own pricing page lists 'Built-in Sales Flows and Lead Routing', and a hands-on community report describes setting up a timed email in minutes. Together these show first-party, rule-driven automation, but the evidence never explicitly documents event-based triggers or how rules are defined. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of event-triggered rules (e.g., record-change triggers), detail on rule conditions and available actions, independent corroboration of event-driven automation depth.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
